tool.name: OGS: ExtractSurface
tool.description: Extracts a 2D surface from a 3D input mesh by specifying a normal vector and an angle.
tool.command: ln -sf '$mesh_input_file' 'mesh_input_file.vtu'; ExtractSurface $ascii_output #if str($angle) --angle '$angle' #end if #if str($z_component) --z-component '$z_component' #end if #if str($y_component) --y-component '$y_component' #end if #if str($x_component) --x-component '$x_component' #end if --mesh-input-file 'mesh_input_file.vtu' --mesh-output-file output_1.vtu

param.label: ascii output
param.help: If the switch is set use ascii instead of binary format for data in the vtu output.

param.label: angle
param.help: tolerated angle (in degrees) between given normal and element normal

param.label: mesh input file
param.help: Input (.vtu). The name of the file containing the input mesh

tool.help: Extracts a 2D surface from a 3D input mesh by specifying a normal vector and an angle. (The surface normal (0, 0, 0) will extract the complete outer boundary of the 3D mesh.) An extensive documentation can be found at https://docs.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/meshing-submeshes/extract-surface
